name: Hot work
description: Welding, cutting, grinding or any other work that can ignite flammable gas.

name: Cold work
description: Maintenance with no ignition source, such as replacing a gasket or a gauge.

name: Confined space entry
description: Entry into a tank, vessel or pit where the air can be toxic, flammable or low in oxygen.

name: Electrical isolation
description: Isolating and locking out electrical equipment so it can be worked on safely.

name: Work at height
description: Work on scaffolds, platforms or lifts where a fall could cause injury.

name: Excavation
description: Digging or trenching near buried pipelines and cables.
